title: Irish Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Irish stew made with tender lamb, root vegetables, and a rich broth.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb in batches, then set aside.
Reduce heat to medium, add more oil if necessary, and cook the onion until softened.
Add the barley and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the stew, carrots, potatoes, lamb, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil.
Cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2-3 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
